notes: 2024、2025 年数量由本站按 Epoch AI notable 模型库（2026-09 下载）统计：按机构所在国计数，多国合作分别计入；中国含中国香港、中国台湾的机构；欧洲含英国、瑞士等。AI Index 2026 使用 2026-04 快照，美国为 59（本站统计 64），两者差异来自 Epoch 的后续收录。不同年份版本的 AI Index 数值（如 2025 版的 40/15）因数据修订不宜与本图混用。
notes_en: Counts for 2024 and 2025 are compiled by this site from the Epoch AI notable models database (downloaded 2026-09): models are counted by the country of the developing organisation, with multinational collaborations counted for each country; China includes organisations in Hong Kong, China and Taiwan, China; Europe includes the UK, Switzerland and others. AI Index 2026 uses a 2026-04 snapshot and reports 59 for the US (64 in this site's count); the difference comes from Epoch's later additions. Figures from other editions of the AI Index (e.g. 40/15 in the 2025 edition) reflect data revisions and should not be mixed with this chart.
